query.after: Optional sequence number of the last committed event the client applied. Without it, or when the server no longer has those events, the snapshot has reset=true and the client should refetch /v1/messages.

notes: The first frame is always a snapshot.
Committed events carry a monotonic seq; live events carry null.
boot_id changes when the server restarts.
A heartbeat arrives at least every 25 seconds.
Close code 4401 means unauthorized; 4409 means the client fell behind and must reconnect with its cursor.
